comment: C ref: unixmain.c's "Do you want to keep the save file?" after a debug-mode restore. Segment 0 saves a debug-mode gnomish Ranger. Segment 1 restores it, keeps the save file, moves and stops mid-game without saving. Segment 2 restores the same kept file again (the moves made in segment 1 are gone), declines to keep it, pages back with ^P, and shows that the rc's time and showexp are overridden by the saved flags. Seeds, clocks, character and keys chosen independently.
